mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility above +10% indicates widespread home confinement; as this series mean-reverts downward toward baseline, retail and recreation footfall rises over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below +10% but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A TRANSIT drop below -45% from baseline triggers a policy response that eases restrictions within two weeks, causing retail and recreation mobility to rise above its recent mean.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses below -45 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses below -45% but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES is below -25% and PARKS is above 0%, outdoor leisure substitutes for retail; as WORKPLACES rises above -25% and PARKS falls below 0%, retail and recreation mobility recovers over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES crosses above -25 and PARKS falls below 0
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -25 and PARKS falls below 0, but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-lockdown reopening regime, GROCERY_PHARM rising above -5% signals a return to normal shopping routines, which lifts retail and recreation mobility over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above -5 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM rises above -5% but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: High RESIDENTIAL above +10% combined with low TRANSIT below -40% locks consumers at home; when RESIDENTIAL falls below +10% and TRANSIT rises above -40%, retail and recreation mobility increases over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below +10 and TRANSIT rises above -40
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below +10% and TRANSIT rises above -40% but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility above 0% indicates outdoor activity that spills over into nearby retail within one week, producing higher retail and recreation mobility over the next week.
failure_condition: PARKS remains above 0% but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not higher than over the last 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in WORKPLACES below -30% and TRANSIT below -50% signal deepening mobility restrictions that suppress retail and recreation mobility over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -30 and TRANSIT falls below -50
failure_condition: WORKPLACES below -30% and TRANSIT below -50% but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC lags TRANSIT by two weeks; a TRANSIT fall greater than 10 points over two weeks predicts a further decline in retail and recreation mobility over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 10 points over 2 weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls more than 10 points over 2 weeks but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than over the last 14 days.
